title: Vikram and Betal: The Wise Decision
moral: Patience and fairness lead to the right decision.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about two friends.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about two friends who found money.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The friends argue over the money.
scenes.text: The friends argued about who should keep the purse.
scenes.image_prompt: two friends arguing over purse cartoon

scenes.summary: They go to a wise elder.
scenes.text: The elder asked them to wait for the owner.
scenes.image_prompt: elder speaking calmly to two friends cartoon

scenes.text: The real owner came and described the purse.
scenes.image_prompt: man describing purse while others listen cartoon

scenes.text: The elder returned the purse to the owner. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: elder giving purse back to man cartoon

story: Two friends argued over found money. A wise elder waited for the real owner and returned it. Vikram said patience and fairness lead to the right decision.
